We need to use correct functional group names: "aldehydes" (plural) and "aliphatic carboxylic acid" or "aromatic carboxylic acid". The target cinnamic acid is aromatic carboxylic acid (aryl attached to COOH). So functional_groups_broken could be ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"]? Actually malonic acid is aliphatic carboxylic acid. In forward reaction, aldehyde and malonic acid are reactants, product is aromatic carboxylic acid (cinnamic acid). So broken groups: aldehydes (the aldehyde is consumed), aliphatic carboxylic acid (malonic acid). Formed: C-C double bonds (C-C double bonds). Also maybe "carboxylic esters"? Not. So functional_groups_formed: ["C-C double bonds"].

Bonds formed: C=C (same). Bonds broken: C-C (the bond between carbonyl carbon and alpha carbon of malonic acid?), C-O (one carboxylate). We'll keep same.

Now search again.
